content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DDMCH Kendujhar Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post at DDMCH Kendujhar is scheduled for 09 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the required qualifications for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include MD/DNB in Pediatrics (first preference), Diploma in Pediatric (next preference), and MBBS if the above are unavailable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Medical Officer post at DDMCH Kendujhar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Medical Officer position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Dharanidhar Medical College & Hospital, Kendujhar, Odisha, 758001.
